description:
## 1.0.1 (2026-11-23)

### ✨ New Features

* Unlock Premium: Eurowag Navi's subscription state is forced to Premium. Trial countdown, trial card and paywall are gone
* Offline maps enabled in addition to online maps
* Full feature set: truck vehicle profiles with all editable parameters (dimensions, weight, axles, ADR), Full traffic tier, speed cameras, lane guidance, driving restrictions, voice instructions, incidents and driving notifications
* Favourites/search history limits raised to 750 places / 500 routes / 500 recent places
* Works signed in, signed out and when the backend feature JWT says free/trial/expired

### Notes

* Pinned to Eurowag Navi 4.18.1-7eb59b0f (versionCode 41801), XAPK
* Morphe Manager merges the XAPK splits before patching
* Server-gated data (live traffic and speed-camera feeds, map downloads/updates, Eurowag Pay, fleet data) still needs a real entitlement

### Install

Add the source in Morphe Manager, pick **Eurowag Navi 4.18.1**, select the XAPK and apply **Unlock Premium**. Morphe merges the XAPK splits automatically.

Source: https://morphe.software/add-source?gitlab=georgewoodall82/eurowag-patches
